episodes.title: Please Be My Friend!
episodes.summary: Ashiya Mizuki is a girl but she attends an all-boys school because high jumper Sano Izumi is there.

episodes.title: I Want to Be with You
episodes.summary: The school doctor Umeda and Sano figure out that Mizuki is a girl. Can she continue staying at the school?

episodes.title: I Won't Lose!
episodes.summary: After Sano stops his friend Rika from slapping Mizuki and yells at Rika, Mizuki and Sano get into a fight.

episodes.title: The Source of Strength
episodes.summary: Sano decides to rejoin the track team, but then his old rival Kagurazaka shows up to provoke him.

episodes.title: Do They Hate Me?
episodes.summary: Sano doesn't seem to remember the last night, but Mizuki also has other troubles: someone has it out for her.

episodes.title: My Big Brother's Coming!
episodes.summary: Mizuki's brother Shizuki unexpectedly comes to Japan. Can she keep keep her secret while he's here?

episodes.title: Because I'm a Guy!
episodes.summary: Dorm 2 is being renovated, so Mizuki needs a place to stay for 2 weeks. Desperate, she turns to Umeda...

episodes.title: It's Not Like We Could Become Lovers
episodes.summary: Tamami is all over Sano, putting Mizuki into a strange mood about her and Sano's relationship.

episodes.title: Can Things Stay This Way?
episodes.summary: Io asks Mizuki if she wants things with Sano to stay this way. Later, Mizuki is in danger!

episodes.title: I Don't Look Good in Women's Clothing!
episodes.summary: It's festival time for Osaka High. The winning dorms gets special privileges, so things get heated.

episodes.title: Nanba-Senpai?
episodes.summary: Dorm 1 plays dirty in the chicken fight against Mizuki's team. Later Nanba has a heated exchange with a woman.

episodes.title: I Was the Same
episodes.summary: Nakatsu finds out that Dorm 1 has a plot against Mizuki. He tells Sano, but Mizuki has already been kidnapped!

episodes.title: Definitely Weird
episodes.summary: Sano's jumping well, and he seems happier. Nakatsu's still confused about Mizuki, but then a girl asks him out?!

episodes.title: Please Make Me Stronger!
episodes.summary: Even though Nakatsu is dating Komatsu, he can't stop thinking about Mizuki. Meanwhile, Mizuki starts karate...

episodes.title: How Did You Know?!
episodes.summary: An unexpected visitor arrives before the school trip, turning Mizuki's daily life upside down.

episodes.title: I'll Wait
episodes.summary: Everyone is enjoying the trip to Hokkaido. But Sano is lost in thought and wanders off, so Mizuki follows him.

episodes.title: I Can't Not Think About It
episodes.summary: During her midnight bath, Mizuki runs into Sano. Shaken by this, she can't look him in the eyes the next day.

episodes.title: It's Fine, Right?
episodes.summary: Julia's worried that someone might find out that Mizuki is a girl. But then Sano's words rock her to the core.

episodes.title: Because I Want to Stay by Your Side Forever
episodes.summary: The picture of Sano, Nakatsu, and Nanba goes viral with girls. A fashion photographer is also interested.

episodes.title: Teacher's Boyfriend?
episodes.summary: Akiha talks the gang into doing a test shoot. He's a good photographer, but is he also Umeda's boyfriend?

episodes.title: Don't Look!!
episodes.summary: The photos turned out great, but Sano's not interested in modeling. So Akiha tries to convince Mizuki.

episodes.title: Did You Do It?!
episodes.summary: Someone sabotaged the shoot and destroyed the photos. So now they're doing a shoot on location.

episodes.title: What Do You Want?
episodes.summary: The joint Christmas ball with St. Blossom is coming up, but Mizuki ends up having to learn the girl steps?

episodes.title: It Can't Be Helped
episodes.summary: Mizuki wants to dance with Sano, but Nakatsu jumps in and asks her to partner with him.
